movelist.name: Flame Charge
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Natural Gift
movelist.effect: Refer to the Move Keywords Berry list. Natural Gift deals damage according to the Berry list and Natural Gift’s Type is also defined there. The Berry’s Digestion Buff is nullified and is not used.

movelist.name: Roost
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. If the user is a Flying Type, it loses the Flying Type until the start of their next turn.

movelist.name: Flail
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Flail’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

abilities.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.effect: While Confused or Slowed, the user gains +3 Evasion. The user is immune to the Vulnerable Condition.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.effect: Connection – Quick Attack. The user may use Quick Attack as a Flying-Type Move.

abilities.name: Rocket
abilities.effect: The user may take their turn at the top of the round. Priority, Interrupt, or Reaction Moves or Abilities cannot be declared in response to the user’s turn.
